title: Mixed Event — Beyond The Dream of That Day — Episode5 An Idol's Roots

meta.Event: Beyond The Dream of That Day
meta.Event Outline: After putting on a successful solo show, MORE MORE JUMP! starts thinking about their next goal. During that time, they're offered a chance to appear on TV. Everyone is excited to hear the news, except Haruka, who doesn't quite share in their optimism...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Why you decided to become an idol in the first place or how you felt back then...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, now might not be a bad time to look back on all that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I want to spread as much hope to as many people as I can...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (We as a group want to do that for everyone we've met, and everyone we're going to meet in the future...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, why did I want to become an idol in the first place? What kind of idol do I want to become? I really need to think about those things...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I... I wanted to become an idol because...

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: “And so, the Princess was able to use her beautiful smile to spread love and courage to people all over.”

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: (This book seemed like it was meant for little kids, but it ended up being pretty fun. The Princess was so cheerful and helped solve so many different problems...)

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: (I should thank the teacher tomorrow for letting me borrow this...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Mother
rows.Line: Haruka, do you have a minute?

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Mother
rows.Line:
Actually, here...!
Grandma just sent you a present.

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Mother
rows.Line: It's your reward for getting 100 on that test you took the other day. You've been wanting this Yudetama pencil case, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Mother
rows.Line:
Hehe...
If only it were easier to make you smile, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line:
No, um...
I'm really happy, but...

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Mother
rows.Line:
No, that's okay! Really!
I know that you couldn't be happier.

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Mother
rows.Line: I'll make sure to tell Grandma that you love her gift.

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, also.
Yudetama's going to be doing a show at a mall a little away from us this weekend.

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Mother
rows.Line:
Would you like to go?
You might even get to shake hands!

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Mother
rows.Line:
We can also invite your father!
Anyway, I'll let you know when dinner's ready.

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: (But I really am happy about the pencil case Grandma sent, and how I get to see Yudetama's show...)

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: (Why can't I just smile like everyone else...?)

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: “And so, the Princess was able to use her beautiful smile to spread love and courage to people all over.”

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Mother
rows.Line:
Yudetama was so adorable!
I'm so glad that you two got to shake hands, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, he was really cute, and I had a lot of fun.

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: But I also feel kind of tired. There were so many people...

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Mother
rows.Line:
Hehe. Very true.
It is already lunch time, so how about we take a break?

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Father
rows.Line: In that case, I'll go buy us something. I saw a nice shop just over there.

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Mother
rows.Line:
Thanks, dear!
But it might be hard for you to carry food for all of us. Why don't we go together?

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Mother
rows.Line: Do you think you can walk, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line:
(So many people...
More than before I think...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Father
rows.Line: Please be careful not to get separated from us, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: (I might get lost if I keep getting bumped and pushed around like this...)

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: (Maybe I should hold her hand just to be safe...)

rows.Speaker: Female Stranger
rows.Line: Did you mix up me with your mommy? I'm sorry, but she's...

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line:
(Oh no...
I got separated from Mommy and Daddy.)

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: (I tried looking for them where we were trying to go, but I couldn't see them because of all these people...)

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: (What happens if I never get to see them again...?)

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line: (Am I going to be stuck here forever...? All alone?!)

rows.Speaker: Little Haruka
rows.Line:
(Who is she...?
Her clothes are so cute...)

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line:
Hm?
I thought you were lost since I found you all alone... But you seem awfully calm. Are you not actually lost?

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line:
Lemme ask my manager...
Hey, I think this little girl's lost. Can you let mall security know?

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: You always manage to find a lost child whenever we put on events in places like this, don't you? I'll let them know right away...

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line:
Don't worry!
I'm sure you'll be reunited with your mommy and daddy in no time. Until then...

rows.Speaker: Event Staff
rows.Line:
Ah, there you are!
You're going on stage soon! We need you on standby!

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line:
What?! Already?!
I was hoping to get a better feel for the place since it's my first time being here.

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line:
Yup. The stage...
Right over there in the middle of that big, open area. That's where I'm gonna be.

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line:
I know...
Why don't you come with me? I bet you're gonna be totally blown away!
